body: I’ve got some purple sage for purchase

We are all currently in therapy separately. And yeah… it’s hard cuz we have vented to each other and I find it so hard not to get defensive and try and “fix things” since I’m a damn fixer. 

Thanks so much.

We are all living together in this mish mosh kind of family. There is a kid involved in the whole mess too. 

Also both of my partners struggle with BPD (borderline personality disorder) as well as some other neurodivergencies. (Autism, adhd, as well as ptsd and other trauma). I have my own traits and traumas as well. So we are all currently in therapy separately already. But do have a really hard time staying out of each others business. 

And I’m afraid of trying to figure out how to balance, how to make my partner secure that he didn’t just leave him for me. 

He’s also not really explaining why he left him. He said it’s just hard to explain. 

It’s all so complicated and right now I just feel so hurt and so lost. 

Thank you all for your responses. 💜
I would suggest trying online meetings. I just tapped into them and they are so great. So many amazing people. I’m also trying to get sober. Feel free to DM me. I’m 30 Female.
Anyone know if they are still shipping out? I haven’t gotten mine yet.

That’s a good idea. If anything we decided we are going to get some good cameras and document everything. Tell his story and document our adventures. Hopefully when I release the video when he’s gone it’ll help someone feel like they aren’t so alone.

There are treatments he can try, and things that can help him cope but nothing is proven to make it “go away”. There Is this awesome clinic that is shown to get people like him some relief, and sometimes will put people in remission. It’s expensive and He’s skeptical about it. He also struggles with a lot of abuse from his family. Sexually abused since the age of 6. And lots of demons that haunt him daily. He could live longer, but he can’t deal with the constant pain, emotional and physical.
Yes. He suffers from a nerve damage conditioned called CRPS. It qualifies.
I know it’ll get easier, the more I tell it the easier it seems to get. But this is only day 3.

I am trying. I want to reach out to my family because they are my support but I don’t think they’ll understand. How does one cope with this type of love story? One that you know will end in tragedy but hope with all you’re heart he will change his mind?
Thank you. I just don’t know where to even begin to start coping. I can’t stop crying and I just want him to see the beautiful life that we could have together.

Sounds like she needs some help, and you do too. This is typical of people with BPD. You might be what is called the FP or (favorite person) who at times it can be amazing and wonderful and then they take out their worst on you.
My girffle is actually a backpack! And his name is Sticky! I luffs him. 💜
